Title: Verify aircraft registration form displays all required fields
Description: AC-1: All four fields are displayed in a two-column grid on desktop viewport
Test Action: Navigate to /register and log in as Operator
Observe the form layout at 1280×720 viewport
Step Expected: Registration Number field is present and visible in the top-left column
Aircraft Type, Manufacturer, and Year of Manufacture fields are all present

Title: Verify Registration Number field accepts valid format
Description: AC-2: Valid registration numbers are accepted
Test Action: Navigate to /register and log in as Operator
Enter 'AB-12345' in the Registration Number field

Step Expected: Field border remains neutral (no red outline)

Title: Verify Registration Number field rejects invalid format
Description: AC-3: Invalid registration numbers are rejected
Test Action: Navigate to /register and log in as Operator
Enter 'abc123' (lowercase letters and no dash) in the Registration Number field
Step Expected: Inline error appears below the field
Error reads: 'Invalid format. Use 1-2 capital letters
